subject: Production degradation: surge of 5xx/429s tied to client retry behavior
messages:
From: Alice Moreno <alice@fintrend.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: support+prod@fintrend.com
Date: Sat, 08 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production: sudden spike in 5xx/429 and timeouts — looks like client retries are amplifying

Jordan —

We just saw a sudden degradation in our production integration with Redwood starting ~14:45 PST. Requests to the /v1/generate endpoint are returning high 5xx rates and 429s; our telemetry shows cascading timeouts and a large number of repeated attempts from our service. We rolled a small client-side change this morning that updated our SDK config to "aggressive" retries (we used the JS SDK defaults, accidentally set maxRetries=8 and no jitter).

Symptoms:
- 5xx rate rose from 0.3% to ~8% within 10 minutes
- 429s soared and latency p95 jumped from 220ms to ~1.4s
- Our service CPU spiked trying to replay requests

We attached recent logs (fintrend-prod-logs-08-08.txt). Can you confirm if any infra changes on your end coincided with this? We need immediate mitigation — we're seeing customer-facing failures and some downstream partners have flagged it.

Thanks,
Alice Moreno
Head of Platform Engineering
FinTrend Analytics

(Attachment: fintrend-prod-logs-08-08.txt)

Jordan / Monica / Alice — quick update from infra:

What we see:
- At ~14:42 PST there was a steep increase in connection attempts from FinTrend's IP range. Token-level traces show repeated identical requests within <500ms windows.
- Redwood's downstream model pool reached queue saturation and began returning 503 when request queues exceeded buffer thresholds; some routes started returning 429 due to our front-door rate gate.

Short-term mitigation applied (15:44):
- Soft throttle: 30rps cap per token for FinTrend at the edge (non-blocking; returns 429 with Retry-After=10s).
- Deprioritized FinTrend traffic to older serving slab to reduce p95 for other customers.
- Enabled enhanced observability for FT tenant (detailed logs + traces). Attached error_rate_graph.png and router_patch.diff (small change to allow tenant-level soft caps).

Next steps (30m-4h):
- Recommend FinTrend roll back client-side aggressive retry settings or set exponential backoff with jitter and maxRetries<=2.
- We'll produce a short technical note with safe SDK defaults and will propose shipping an SDK patch to surface safer defaults in the next release.

I'll stay on this call until stable.

Marcus Lin
Head of Infra Reliability, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: error_rate_graph.png) (Attachment: router_patch.diff)
